_doc.about: Your plugin-dev-guard settings. Plugin updates never touch this file. Every value below is the default, so this file changes nothing until you edit it. Keys that start with _ are ignored.
_doc.owner: Your GitHub account. With marketplaces = "auto", a marketplace whose GitHub repo belongs to this account counts as yours. Also used by plugin-dev-check with scan_dirs. Example: "octocat"
_doc.marketplaces: Which marketplaces are yours: "auto" (every marketplace added from a local folder, plus the ones on GitHub owned by owner) or a list of names. Example: ["my-plugins"]
_doc.guard: "all" stops edits to the installed copy of any plugin; "mine" only to plugins from your marketplaces (and your install_dirs).
_doc.sources: Where your source repos live: a folder that holds them (or a list of folders), or a map of plugin or marketplace name to repo path. Example: "~/code/plugins" or {"my-plugin": "~/code/my-plugin"}
_doc.install_dirs: Other installed copies to protect, outside the plugins folder: a map of name to path, or a list of paths (name = folder name without -src). Example: {"my-cli": "~/.local/share/my-cli-src"}
_doc.exempt: Paths inside an install dir that may be written (runtime data, logs). Example: ["~/.local/share/my-cli-src/logs"]
_doc.pass_minutes: How long the pass file lets edits through after the user approves one.
_doc.scan_dirs: plugin-dev-check only: folders searched for repos of owner that are outside sources. Example: ["~/code"]
_doc.tip: A line added at the end of the message Claude sees when an edit is stopped. Example: "Then add a to-do to port the change."
